messages.author: b82af643aafe86d2
messages.subject: Stan and cran
parts:
I recall seeing postings where it was said that Stan isn't on cran because it's too big.  

If that's true, does the strategy adopted for xlsx and xlsxjars apply to Stan?  They split out part of the work into xlsxjars and created the correct dependencies.

Bill

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: Stan and cran
parts:
On Thursday, August 21, 2014 1:31:13 AM UTC-4, Bill Harris wrote:
I recall seeing postings where it was said that Stan isn't on cran because it's too big.

It was more that it was deemed unnecessarily big when it bundled much of Boost and Eigen. Now that rstan_2.4.0 depends on the BH and RcppEigen packages, that shouldn't be an issue. It passes the CRAN checks now, but we would probably have to get rid of the set_cppo() function. We were planning to put in on CRAN for 3.0, but now it looks like there will be more 2.x releases, so we might do it for 2.5.0.

Ben
